tools.name: check_account
tools.description: Return the current plan, available lead credits, per-search limit, and active jobs. Call this before any credit-spending search or enrichment.

tools.name: find_locations
tools.description: Resolve a city or region to Mapsdata's canonical location label. Use the returned label and country_code when calling search_businesses. Does not use credits.

tools.name: find_categories
tools.description: Find canonical Google business category names for a niche. Use display_name as the search query when an exact category is appropriate. Does not use credits.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Start one asynchronous Google Maps business search in one canonical location. This uses Pay on Find. First call check_account and find_locations, tell the user the maximum cost (up to 3 credits per business, capped by the available balance), and note that starting an enriched run requires at least 1

tools.name: list_searches
tools.description: List this account's discovery searches, newest first, including searches created in the Mapsdata dashboard, REST API, and MCP. Use scope to narrow the source. Does not use credits.

tools.name: search_status
tools.description: Get progress and credit usage for one discovery search. Does not use credits.

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Return one page of enriched businesses already found by a discovery search. Results may be read while the job is running. Continue while has_more is true, then fetch all pages once more after the job reaches completed. Does not use credits.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get one complete business record by the business ID returned in a search or enrichment result page. Does not use credits.

tools.name: enrich_businesses
tools.description: Start asynchronous contact enrichment for businesses the user already has. This uses Pay on Find. First call check_account, state the maximum cost (up to 3 credits per submitted business, capped by the available balance), and obtain confirmation. Starting the job requires at least 1 credit per busin

tools.name: list_enrichments
tools.description: List this account's supplied-business enrichment jobs, newest first. Use scope to narrow the source. Does not use credits.

tools.name: enrichment_status
tools.description: Get progress and credit usage for a supplied-business enrichment job. Does not use credits.

tools.name: get_enrichment_results
tools.description: Return one page of supplied-business enrichment results. Continue while has_more is true and fetch all pages again after completion. Does not use credits.
